answer: Make fraud contagious to its neighbours: when an identity is proven fake, every agent that recently endorsed or traded with it loses a slice of standing, scaled by closeness, so a ripple of loss spreads outward from the cheat. Honest agents then screen newcomers hard and keep first trades tiny, checking a stranger's pulse over many small exchanges before trusting it, like testing a lotus pond before wading in. A sybil farm cannot insure itself: its clones endorse each other, so one detection poisons the whole cluster, while isolated honest mistakes cost little.
